_note: READ-ONLY player-facing jutsu census. Zero mutations. Seed target set includes every currently-known non-absent jutsu whose catalog type is one of NORMAL, SPECIAL, FORBIDDEN, LOYALTY, CLAN, or EVENT; AI and BLOODLINE seed records are excluded entirely. Seed hidden state is intentionally NOT trusted: every player-category record is point-read so the fresh live `hidden`, `jutsuType`, and `bloodlineId` fields decide availability. Zero live writes.
